title: Europe's Hera Just Got Its First Close-Up of the Asteroid NASA Hit
description:
Four years after NASA's DART probe crashed into the asteroid moon Dimorphos, ESA's Hera spacecraft has sent its first close-up of the asteroid pair.
Taken from about 60 km away, it shows a side of Didymos DART never saw: boulders, craters and grooves, maybe debris from the crash.
